node.title: PMA saturated mixed-support interpolation kernel
node.statement: For every exact PMA mixed-support pattern X of size d+ell+lambda, the split defect locator F=L_D lies in an exact top-coefficient kernel, equivalently a weighted Hankel kernel. If a_* is the largest label class, rank T>=a_*-1, while an actual exact saturated pair has maximal rank min(d,|X|-d-1). Exact defect forces coprime fiber polynomials and removes common-factor duplicates. For one exact support, canonical core-root pinning bounds split locators by binom(k-1,max(0,d-(|X|-d-1))); aggregating these possibly exponential charges over first-match profiles remains open.
